title: League of Legends: New Dawn overhaul lands in 2027 ⚔️
subject: leagueoflegends
description:
Will New Dawn bring you back to League? 👇

Riot Games revealed League of Legends: New Dawn, the 2027 overhaul formerly known as League Next, during the Worlds 2026 grand final at Barclays Center in Brooklyn on November 14, 2026. It is an update to the current game, not a sequel, with a full reveal planned for January 2027. Bilibili Gaming beat Gen.G 3-1 to win Worlds.

Sources: KeenGamer (Nov 14, 2026), Strafe (Nov 14, 2026), Inven Global (Nov 14, 2026), Esports.net (Nov 15, 2026)

scenes.text: League of Legends is getting a full overhaul in 2027.
Riot showed it on November 14, during the Worlds final at Barclays Center in Brooklyn.
It's called New Dawn, formerly League Next.

scenes.text: It isn't a sequel. Riot wants to keep improving the 17-year-old game, not replace it.
The teaser showed a brighter Summoner's Rift, a redesigned jungle, new minions and a new champion select.
That night, Bilibili Gaming beat Gen.G 3-1 for its first world title. More on New Dawn comes in January.
